title: access channel — schema-first (AFB backend<->AFB frontend only; not part of afb.execution.v1 wire)
description: Negotiated via auth.support (capability id afbws.access.channel.v1). Freemium access model: tier (who) x capabilities (personal permissions) x mode (what is available now), see common.v1.json#/$defs/access. Messages mirror the backend's access database (tables tiers, members, users, subscriptions). Same convention as afbws.link/afbws.screener: ONE schema id per operation (`afbws.access.<op>.v1`, no .request/.response suffixes); the same schema is the request and its response (echoes `request_id`); response-only fields are forbidden in a request. `request_id` is required in every client request. Operations (manager only, others get error `forbidden`): `roles.get`/`roles.set` (tiers and members; replace the config-channel op `roles`), `users.list`, `user.set` (trial end / manual grant), `stats` (weekly conversion). Server-initiated: push `afbws.access.state.v1` (no `request_id`) and `afbws.access.denied.v1` — the gate's refusal of a request of ANY channel (sent on the refused request's channel, with its `request_id`). Whole-request failures of this channel: `afbws.access.error.v1`. See AFB/docs/ws/access.md.

window.description: Daily time window, Moscow time: `from` — start, `to` — end. `to` < `from` = across midnight (e.g. 22:00-02:00).

policy.description: Mode policy of a tier (`tiers.policy` in the backend's access database). A tier WITH a policy is `full` (with the limits of `as_tier`) while a manual grant, the trial, a time window (stage 3: a showcase instrument) is active, otherwise `basic` with its own limits. A tier without a policy (null) is always `full` with its own limits. The `trade` capability and a paid tier are always `full`.

trial_days.description: Trial length in days; 0 or absent = no trial.

workday.description: Window of a trading day (MOEX calendar); null or absent = no window.

weekend.description: Window of a non-trading day (MOEX calendar); null or absent = no window.

tierRow.description: One tier (one row of the `tiers` table).

title.description: Label shown in the manager UI.

rank.description: Priority when a user matches several tiers (higher wins); unique among tiers. The tier with the minimal rank is the default for users not matched by any member.

paid.description: Paid subscription: subscription periods are logged on login, the tier counts in conversion.

policy.description: Mode policy; null — always `full` with its own limits.

member.description: Who gets a tier or a capability (one row of the `members` table).

role.description: A tier name (from `tiers`) or a capability name (set defined by the backend code).

token.description: `id_<id>` — local user, `gc_<id>` — GetCourse user, `gc:<group id>` — GetCourse group.

userRow.description: One user who has logged in at least once (row of the `users` table + resolved tier/capabilities + the last subscription period).

trial_started_at.description: null — the trial has never been given.

grant_until.description: Manual extension: `full` until this moment; null — none.

subscription.description: The last paid subscription period; null — never subscribed.

showcase.description: Instrument showcase (stage 3): instruments of the global catalog collection `collection` work as in `full`.

collection.description: Id of a global catalog collection; null — not chosen.

subscription.description: One paid subscription period (row of the `subscriptions` table).

getcourseGroup.description: GetCourse group (a member token references it as `gc:<id>`).

statsWeek.description: One calendar week of conversion statistics.

rolesGet.title: afbws.access.roles.get.v1 — read tiers and members (request / response), manager only.

capabilities.description: Response only: capability names (the set is defined by the backend code).

getcourse_groups.description: Response only: GetCourse groups (hints for choosing a `gc:` token).

getcourse_groups_error.description: Response only: why GetCourse groups could not be fetched; null — fetched.

rolesSet.title: afbws.access.roles.set.v1 — replace tiers and members (request / response), manager only.
rolesSet.description: Request: `tiers[]` (at least one; `tier` names must be unique — checked by the server) and `members[]` — replace-all of both tables. Response: the saved snapshot, as afbws.access.roles.get.v1.

tiers.description: Tier names must be unique (JSON Schema cannot express uniqueness by key — the server rejects duplicates with validation_error).

capabilities.description: Response only: capability names (the set is defined by the backend code).

getcourse_groups.description: Response only: GetCourse groups (hints for choosing a `gc:` token).

getcourse_groups_error.description: Response only: why GetCourse groups could not be fetched; null — fetched.

usersList.title: afbws.access.users.list.v1 — all users (request / response), manager only.
usersList.description: Request: only `request_id`. Response: `items[]` — every user who has logged in at least once (no server-side filtering or paging).

userSet.title: afbws.access.user.set.v1 — set a user's trial end and/or manual grant (request / response), manager only.
userSet.description: Request: `user_id` + `trial_ends_at` and/or `grant_until` (at least one; null removes). The first `trial_ends_at` for a user without a trial (`trial_started_at` null) also sets `trial_started_at` = now. Response: `user_id` + `item` — the updated row. Unknown user -> error `not_found`.

trial_ends_at.description: Request only: new trial end; null — remove the trial end.

grant_until.description: Request only: manual grant until; null — remove the grant.

stats.title: afbws.access.stats.v1 — weekly conversion statistics (request / response), manager only.
stats.description: Request: `from`, `to` (dates, inclusive, Moscow). Response echoes `from`/`to` and carries `weeks[]` (oldest first), one per calendar week intersecting the range. `new_users` — users whose `first_seen_at` falls in the week; `trials_started` — users whose `trial_started_at` falls in the week; `converted` — paid subscription periods started in the week; `active` — users whose `last_seen_at` falls in the week.

state.title: afbws.access.state.v1 — new effective access of this connection (server push only).
state.description: Sent without `request_id` when the effective access changes (mode switch at `until`, a manager's change of tiers/members/trial/grant). Carries the whole new `access` block; the client replaces the one from auth.ok.

denied.title: afbws.access.denied.v1 — the access gate refused a request of ANY channel (server -> client).
denied.description: Answer to a request of any schema-first channel that the current `mode` does not allow. `channel` is the channel of the REFUSED request and `request_id` echoes it, so the per-channel request/response client rejects the pending request. `reason`: `basic` — feature not available in basic mode; `showcase` — basic mode with showcase, the instrument is not in the showcase; `held` — activation of an alarm/trade plan while the owner's objects are held. `feature` — gate feature id (e.g. `datasets`, `participants`, `virtual`, `screener`, `alarm.activate`). `until` — when `full` becomes available (next window/trial), null if unknown. `message` — ready-to-show text.

error.title: afbws.access.error.v1 — typed error for a whole request (server -> client).
error.description: `code` is a closed subset of common errorCode: `forbidden` (not a manager), `validation_error`, `not_found` (unknown user), `invalid_channel`, `invalid_schema`, `internal_error`.
